claims.text: United Russia received nearly 58 percent of the party-list vote with about 58 percent of precincts counted in Russia's parliamentary election.
Voter turnout at the close of polls in the Russian parliamentary election stood at 56.66 percent.
The election was the first parliamentary vote held in Russia since the start of its full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022.
Authorities in Kyiv denounced voting in Russian-occupied areas of Ukraine as illegal and urged foreign governments not to recognize the results.
Russia's Defence Ministry reported that its forces shot down 1,110 Ukrainian drones across Russia, Crimea, and the Black Sea.
Russian election chief Ella Pamfilova stated that Russia's electronic voting system was targeted by cyberattacks.
Moscow Mayor Sergey Sobyanin stated that more than 1,600 drones were intercepted and shot down, including 450 aimed at Moscow.
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated Ukraine used domestically produced Flamingo cruise missiles to strike targets in Moscow.
A drone strike caused damage to a facility at the Moscow oil refinery.
A 44-year-old woman was killed in Sofyino after a drone struck a three-storey residential building.
Ukrainian officials stated that nine people, including three children, were killed in Russian attacks in the Kyiv and Sumy regions on Saturday.
The US Virtual Embassy in Iran issued a security alert urging American citizens to leave Iran immediately and avoid travelling there for any reason.
Saudi-led coalition forces intercepted a ballistic missile launched towards Riyadh and reported attempted attacks targeting Bish, Taif, Farasan, and Yanbu.
US President Donald Trump stated he is in a 'deciding mode' regarding potential military action, continued economic pressure, or a deal with Iran.
Iran's Khatam al-Anbiya Central Headquarters warned that all US bases and interests in the region will face continuous and painful attacks if Washington resumes military action against Tehran.
Iran's Revolutionary Guards stated its aerospace force tracked and destroyed a US military MQ-1 drone over the Strait of Hormuz.
Houthi military spokesman Yahya Saree stated Saudi Arabia conducted 28 air strikes targeting the governorates of Taiz, Al-Jawf, and Marib.
Tehran stated it learned the US may be planning new strikes and warned of retaliation without limitations.
UK Cabinet minister Bridget Phillipson stated the UK's upcoming budget will be made more difficult by Donald Trump's war with Iran due to oil supply disruptions and inflation.
German Chancellor Friedrich Merz called the CDU's election performance in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern 'a disaster' but stated he would remain in office.
Public broadcasters projected the far-right AfD to win 38% of the vote in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern, ahead of the SPD on 35%.
In Berlin's state election, Die Linke led projections with nearly 26% of the vote, ahead of the CDU on 19%.
German Chancellor Friedrich Merz cleared his calendar and skipped a planned trip to New York for the UN General Assembly following election losses for his CDU party.
German Chancellor Friedrich Merz's personal approval ratings hover just above 10 percent.
The CDU secured 4.9 percent of the vote in Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania, marking its worst state election result since 1949.
The far-right AfD party leads national opinion polls in Germany with approximately 30 percent support.
US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent and Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng led talks that lasted around eight hours at JPMorgan Chase's headquarters in New York.
The US proposed creating a 'US-China AI dialogue' that includes a notification mechanism for high-level national security incidents resulting from AI.
US President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping are scheduled to hold a summit meeting at the White House on Thursday.
US Trade Representative Jamieson Greer stated export controls on advanced AI chips and semiconductor manufacturing equipment were not part of the proposed US-China AI notification mechanism.
The US-China trade truce agreed upon in Busan, South Korea, in October 2025 is scheduled to expire on November 10.
Anthropic chief executive Dario Amodei called for a worldwide pacing of frontier AI development requiring cooperation with China.
China released the third iteration of its AI safety governance framework addressing risks from AI agents, cybersecurity threats from frontier models, and recursive self-improvement.
